title: Household Add-On Membership: late fee, suspension and reactivation basis
content:
## Scope
This document states, for each Household Add-On Membership tier, the flat late fee charged on a failed dues charge, the number of consecutive missed charges that trigger suspension, the grace period a suspended add-on may remain suspended before administrative removal, the reactivation fee, and the reactivation window before permanent removal.

## Per-tier basis
| Tier | Late fee (flat) | Missed charges before suspension | Past-due grace period | Reactivation fee | Reactivation window |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Spouse Add-On | $10.00 | 2 | 15 calendar days | $10.00 | 30 calendar days |
| Domestic Partner Add-On | $10.00 | 2 | 15 calendar days | $10.00 | 30 calendar days |
| Dependent Child Add-On | $5.00 | 2 | 15 calendar days | $0.00 | 30 calendar days |
| Young Adult Add-On | $5.00 | 2 | 15 calendar days | $0.00 | 30 calendar days |
| Senior Parent Add-On | $5.00 | 3 | 20 calendar days | $0.00 | 30 calendar days |
| Household Multi-Add-On | $5.00 | 2 | 15 calendar days | $0.00 | 30 calendar days |

## Points of judgement
- The grace period and the reactivation window are both counted in full calendar days from the add-on's suspension; the grace period bounds how long a suspended add-on may sit unpaid before administrative removal, while the reactivation window bounds how long after suspension the outstanding balance may still be paid to bring the add-on current rather than have it permanently removed.
- The Senior Parent Add-On is the only tier that departs from the pattern shared by every other tier: it tolerates one additional missed charge before suspending (3 rather than 2) and allows five more grace-period days (20 rather than 15) before administrative removal becomes possible, while its reactivation fee, like every tier but the Spouse and Domestic Partner Add-Ons, is waived.
- The Spouse Add-On and the Domestic Partner Add-On are the only tiers that charge a reactivation fee ($10.00) to bring a suspended add-on current; every other tier reinstates at no additional charge beyond the outstanding balance itself.
- Comparing the two figures that move together for the Senior Parent Add-On: its grace period of 20 calendar days runs 5 days longer than the 15-calendar-day grace period shared by every other tier, while its reactivation window of 30 calendar days is the same length shared by every tier.
